name: development
subject: how cratylus itself is built, checked and released: its repository and history, its checks, its CI and its releases
relation: Cratylus develops itself by its own workflow, as any user would, but its development is not the product: the workflow, agents, corpus and delivery contexts describe what users receive, and this context how cratylus is built, checked and released; its own contexts are held by the generic architect, with no persona.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Its description states only its subject and place, each fact once.
